probe.scope: Immutable packed inputs and old probabilities; one PPO iteration, bounded, content checked

admission.scope: Content-checked selector admission within one Dataset

cpu_preparation.scope: Ordered CPU-only process collation; RNG and sampling in main process. Private iteration-local mapped inputs, bounded output files; deleted before return. peak_output_bytes is a conservative bound, not process RSS.

opening_objective.scope: Eligible nonforced opening actions only, including post-fork openings. Detached capped old-T1/actual-behavior weights, no minibatch renormalization. Returns/GAE remain from the collected behavior trajectories.

reward_distribution.scope: One complete-game observation per learner seat; population moments, not independent decisions

receipt.scope: Fresh ordinary trajectories, in-sample calibration; not a strength guarantee

search.reason: Teacher search and distillation disabled by configuration

inference_batching.scope: Per-collection count deltas; pending-position peak is cumulative

utilization.inference_model_scope: Counts, sums and histograms are per-collection deltas; queue_wait_max_seconds is since service start

utilization.scope: ordinary collection; actor/inference phase times overlap; actor_python_* measures process CPU, not total machine or GPU utilization

search.reason: Teacher search and distillation disabled by configuration

utilization.inference_model_scope: Counts, sums and histograms are per-collection deltas; queue_wait_max_seconds is since service start

utilization.scope: ordinary collection; actor/inference phase times overlap; actor_python_* measures process CPU, not total machine or GPU utilization

value_preservation.scope: After PPO, before PPG. All critic-train rows for loss; nonforced learner PPO probe for four-seat utility RMS. True descriptors, no dropout; heldouts excluded from fitting. Core uses beta*value_weight; existing local-head weights are preserved separately.
value_preservation.actor_kl_scope: Unchanged raw-T1 PPO probe and separate behavior-policy guard; compare prior detach runs on the same recipe

categorical_probe.kl_scope: categorical_kl is raw T1 movement and the LR signal. Raw T1 and actual-behavior exact KL each retain the PPO per-step cap. Opening-only KL is a diagnostic; sampled KL remains behavior-policy movement.
categorical_probe.scope: Exact KL(old raw T1 || new raw T1) plus separate behavior-policy KL on the proportional era/phase nonforced probe; PPO per-step early stopping and optional LR feedback

reward_distribution.scope: One complete-game observation per learner seat; population moments, not independent decisions

utility_calibration.reason: DCPG fresh targets are fitted only in the value phase

search.reason: Teacher search and distillation disabled by configuration

inference_batching.scope: Per-collection count deltas; pending-position peak is cumulative

utilization.inference_model_scope: Counts, sums and histograms are per-collection deltas; queue_wait_max_seconds is since service start

replay_ingress.scope: Reader-task CPU excludes process startup and result serialization; worker elapsed phases overlap across readers. Wall is the final join/merge; average cores uses the full streaming interval when enabled.

utilization.scope: ordinary collection; actor/inference phase times overlap; actor_python_* measures process CPU, not total machine or GPU utilization

historical_opponents.sampling: Independent PFSP snapshot seats including IL, with the same uniform floor; IL checkpoint retained as evaluation/calibration anchor

sampling.scope: Actual completed tables and learner seats; forced decisions are critic-only. Table fractions do not define PPO sample fractions.

legacy_profiles.scope: Actual completed ordinary legacy seats; pottery-flex remains evaluation-only

curriculum.scope: Ordinary game tables only; teacher/evaluation games and optimizer steps do not advance this clock
